/********************************************************************/

   #else                                                     /* @B2A*/
      typedef long long      off_t;         /* Extend off_t for Large
                                               Files sizes.     @B2A*/
   #endif                                                   /* @B2A*/

#endif

/********************************************************************/
/* Standard type definitions                                        */
/********************************************************************/

typedef unsigned char           u_char;
typedef unsigned int            u_int;
typedef unsigned short          u_short;
typedef unsigned long           u_long;

typedef unsigned char           uchar;
typedef unsigned int            uint;
typedef unsigned short          ushort;
typedef unsigned long           ulong;

/********************************************************************/
/* Definitions relating to the select() function.  Includes the     */
/* typedef for fd_set and the macros needed to manipulate variables */
/* of type fd_set.                                                  */
/********************************************************************/

#ifndef FD_SETSIZE
  #define FD_SETSIZE    200           /* Maximum descriptors in set */
#endif

/******************************************/
/* fd_set is a minimum of 7 integers  @A6A*/
/* (up to 224 bits) for compatibility @A6A*/
/* with previous releases.  It may be @A6A*/
/* larger, depending on the value of  @A6A*/
/* FD_SETSIZE.                        @A6A*/
/******************************************/

typedef struct fd_set{
  unsigned int fdes[((FD_SETSIZE) <= 224) ? (7) :
                    ((((FD_SETSIZE)-1)/(8*sizeof(int)))+1)]; /*@A6C*/
} fd_set;

#define FD_ZERO(fds)  (memset(fds,0,sizeof(fd_set)))  /* set all 0  */
#define FD_SET(fd, fds)  \
      ((fds)->fdes[(fd)/32] |= (1 << ((fd)%32)))      /* set bits   */
#define FD_CLR(fd, fds)   \
      ((fds)->fdes[(fd)/32] &= ~(1 << ((fd)%32)))     /* clear bits */
#define FD_ISSET(fd, fds)  \
(((fds)->fdes[(fd)/32]&(1 << ((fd)%32)))? 1 : 0)      /* check bits */

/********************************************************************/
/*  Constants used for fields in qlg_nls_t                          */
/********************************************************************/

  #define QLG_JOB_CCSID    0x00000000 /* Use the job CCSID value    */
  #define QLG_JOB_COUNTRY  0x0000     /* Use the job language value */
  #define QLG_JOB_LANG     0x000000   /* Use the job country value  */
#endif  /* not POSIX.1 defined symbolic */

/********************************************************************/
/*  NLS structure used in path name.  This defines the extra        */
/*  information needed to make the path names NLS enabled.          */
/********************************************************************/

typedef struct {
   int     ccsid;              /* CCSID of the path name            */
   char    country_id[2];      /* country identifier of path name   */
   char    language_id[3];     /* language identifier of pathname   */
   char    nls_reserved[3];    /* reserved, must be null            */
} qlg_nls_t;

/********************************************************************/
/*  AS/400 Object Type used in the stat structure.                  */
/********************************************************************/

typedef char qp0l_objtype_t[11];              /* AS/400 Object Type */

#pragma datamodel(pop)                                       /* @B4A*/

#endif  /* __types_h */
